COMPANY_SETUP.DESCRIPTION: Set up your workspace and bring your team on board to start managing tasks seamlessly.

STEP1.TITLE: What's your company name?
STEP1.DESCRIPTION: Every workspace needs a name. Choose something your team recognizes.
STEP1.LABEL: Company Name

STEP2.TITLE: Establish policies
STEP2.DESCRIPTION: Write down your main company guidelines for your workspace users in both English and Arabic.

STEP3.TITLE: Provide workspace document
STEP3.DESCRIPTION: Upload the official, signed Policy Document that team members will need to review.
STEP3.LABEL: Policy Document (PDF)

STEP4.TITLE: Bring your team on board
STEP4.DESCRIPTION: Add email addresses of team members you want to invite immediately. You can also skip this and invite them later.
STEP4.LABEL: Invite Team (Emails)

landing.subtitle: TaskPilot is the clean, fast, and intelligent way to manage your daily tasks, team projects, and focus time. All in one beautiful workspace.
landing.quote1: Empower your team with AI-driven insights to achieve more in less time.
landing.quote2: Streamline your workflow seamlessly and focus on what truly matters.
landing.quote3: Experience unprecedented productivity with our beautifully crafted workspace.
landing.smarterSolutions: Smarter solutions. Greater velocity of work.

ai.title: AI-powered intelligence
features: Make work management your team's superpower with TaskPilot AI.
Get personalized insights and deeper analysis.
Tailored solutions to tackle any challenge.

landing.journeySubtitle: A seamless collaborative journey from setup to success.

step1.title: Setup & Invite
step1.desc: Project Manager registers the company and invites the team.

step2.title: Onboarding
step2.desc: Employee accepts the invitation, sets up their account, and uploads their CV.

step3.title: AI Project Creation
step3.desc: Project Manager creates a new project effortlessly with the help of AI.

step4.title: Task Assignment
step4.desc: Project Manager assigns specific tasks and deadlines to the team.

step5.title: Execution & Completion
step5.desc: The employee tracks tasks via an interactive board, syncs deadlines with Google Calendar, and can chat with company policies and the Agile Coach for instant support to ensure a smooth workflow.

step6.title: Review & Insights
step6.desc: Project Manager studies the sprint retrospective, gathers final articles, and reviews information diagrams.
